label: Screen-Washing Rocker Station
description: A heavy-duty wooden frame with mesh bottoms, suspended over a water source, used to wash away clay and sand from bulk matrix samples.

components.function: Holds the matrix and allows the user to 'agitate' it in the water.
The source material being dumped into the screens.
Used to gently break down stubborn clay clumps that don't dissolve by rocking alone.

game_mechanics.agitation_mini_game: Player must rock the frame at the right rhythm to pass sediment without 'abrading' the tiny fossils inside.
game_mechanics.yield_calculation: The cleaner the wash, the easier the 'Sorting' phase will be back in the lab.
